referenceSources.title: Peugeot 106 Ph1 body kits, Peugeot 106 Ph1 fibre and bodywork parts for competition
referenceSources.description:
A white Peugeot 106 Maxi rally car powers through a narrow mountain pass, its rear tires spraying gravel and dust. The vehicle’s wide fenders, roll cage, and Michelin-branded bumpers underscore its competition-ready setup. The license plate “878 AAN 13” and the “Auto Body Shop Epifasione” decal on the hatch add authentic rally details.

The accompanying metadata lists a full range of body kits and parts for the Peugeot 106 Mk1, including Rallye, XSI, and Maxi variants. Components such as carbon fiber bumpers, fiberglass fenders, Kevlar protectors, and polycarbonate windows are detailed with reference codes and prices. Complete kits for wide-body and Maxi configurations, as well as rally lamp pods and mounting hardware, are offered, all priced in euros excluding VAT and freight.
